# gemoji data

Source: https://github.com/github/gemoji/tree/fadaeaf1f1a9be82b321316a6c5502e43138b2f6

Vendored db/emoji.json unchanged, under the accompanying MIT license.
No emoji images or executable code are included. macOS draws Unicode glyphs.

Pinned data SHA-256: `b174ae2aeb321b52f64adb9ff412f966a7f338839d780784dd15dcad702c2dd6`.
1,870 entries / 1,913 aliases; highest declared Unicode version 15.0.
The catalog has metadata for skin-tone-capable glyphs; LibreTypist currently
uses the explicit Unicode mappings and does not generate tone variants.
